narrative_synthesis: Monday into Tuesday was a 'what is work for now' day. SahilBloom's 'Things that improved my life 10x' list led with 205.7K views and 2,172 saves, levelsio's post-AGI work takes pulled 190.3K and 114.1K, and emollick noted that only 1 of 270 jobs in the 1950 census is now gone. On the AI side, gregisenberg joked that being mean to your AI gets better work (71.2K) and called open-sourcing your SaaS the new playbook (819 saves), while petergyang shared how to get Claude to design without slop. In Indochina, Vietnam is building an AI fraud alert network across banks and telcos, Ho Chi Minh City proposed free open data for AI training, Thailand's Fortal is making AI-assisted Thai short dramas, and Cambodia's Bakong was warned about AI-driven fraud.

indochina_ai.title: Vietnam is setting up an AI-based online fraud alert network: banks, e-wallets, telecoms, social platforms, e-commerce and logistics firms send suspicious numbers, accounts and links to a central system, where AI scores the risk and warns members before victims are hit
indochina_ai.flag: government-led consumer-protection tech (neutral, no political angle)

indochina_ai.title: Ho Chi Minh City's science department opened consultation on a draft resolution that would give firms and researchers in a planned 200-hectare innovation district free access to de-identified open datasets for training AI and LLMs, plus shared labs, AI data centres and a regulatory sandbox (draft only)

Fortal Entertainment, a Thai AI entertainment startup, is adapting Thai novels into short-drama mini-series made with its own AI tools (Fortal Studio) and streaming them on its SiamSun app, aiming to win viewers back from imported short dramas; authors get licence fees and a revenue share, and creative decisions stay with people

At the Black Swan 2026 summit in Phnom Penh, experts warned that the Bakong payment system faces new AI-driven fraud risks and that 'agentic payments' started by machines on users' behalf will need new rules and protections
